snippet.title: Old School Runescape - Leagues VI Demonic Pacts Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts is the latest instalment of our wildly popular seasonal game mode, Leagues. It unleashes powerful gameplay modifiers, rapid XP, explosive loot, reality-warping relics and combat masteries, alongside some truly demonic cosmetic rewards! 

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
